newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CEG, Riogas go on sale Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CEG, Riogas go on sale Monday.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state gas firm CEG and piped gas distributor Riogas, Brazil's first state-owned gas firms to be privatized, will be sold Monday in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio stock exchange.
CEG and Riogas will be auctioned at bases price of 423 million reais ($395.3 million) and 141 million reais ($131.8 million), respectively.

The 51 companies that have signed up for the auction have to deposit financial guarantees with the stock exchange clearing house Friday if they want to bid at the auction set for 1000 local time/0900 EDT/1300 GMT Monday.

Investors will have to present individual offers for both companies and whoever places the highest combined bid for both gas firms will win. The state government expects the auction to achieve a premium of more than 30 percent on the minimum price.
The winning bidder can pay up to 10 million reais ($9.3 million) worth of the CEG's sale price with privatization bonds.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
